verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a live llms.txt at docs.usebruno.com that indexes Markdown versions of the docs pages, which an agent can ingest directly. Bruno also publishes agent-oriented integration guides, including AGENTS.md guidance for Codex and setup docs for Cursor and VS Code Copilot. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully consuming llms.txt, evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: you can add an `AGENTS.md` at your project root so Codex understands how to generate and work with Bruno collections.
With Bruno's local-first approach you can configure Cursor to automate your API development workflow.
